decisions.statement: The items named are the ones the rule takes where every rule above it has run.
An item the rule would take alone and does not take here is named as shadowed.
A shadowed item names the first rule above this one that takes it.
Every item rule is above every ordered rule when the shadow is worked out.
The items are gathered by the item they are, rather than by the stack.
An id no rule the addon compiled carries refuses the call.
Nothing here reads the rule store, so a rule is named by its id rather than its title.

definition: the command naming the items one category rule takes and what takes the rest
